business.about: Aarti Industries Ltd, the flagship company of the Aarti group, manufacturing organic and inorganic chemicals at its major facilities in Vapi, Jhagadia, Dahej and Kutch, in Gujarat and in Tarapur in Maharashtra. The company has a strong market position in the NCB-based specialty chemicals segment. [1]
business.in_their_words: We are actually considering capacity expansion being pushed by requests from our customers. PDA is one chain where we are reevaluating how we should utilize those assets in the most efficient manner. But there, at this point in time, we are not pursuing strategic growth from a volume standpoint and for ethylati on, with our multiproduct strategy, including MEA, DEA and some of the other specialty ethylation/propylation-based chemistries, we expect the volume growth to continue there as well.

results.read: Revenue +75% YoY; EBITDA margin compressed 268 bps YoY to 11% — the lowest in 9 quarters; PAT +58% — sales growth didn't reach the bottom line.

calls: Growth is decelerating: revenue CAGR 7.8% over 3y vs 13.0% over 5y
Margins compressing: 14% latest vs 20% average of prior years
Heavy capex under way: CWIP is 34% of fixed assets
Strong cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is 1.75× reported profit
Free cash flow negative in 5 of the last 5 years
